instruction.text: We'll begin by looking at a door. We're going to turn all the way around and walk up the stairs that we see to our right. After walking up the stairs we're going to walk to the black desk, and we're going to proceed to move beyond the black chair that we see in front of us. Now we're going to walk all the way down the narrow pathway that we have between the glass doors and the various wooden tables. We're going to walk all the way down until we reach a wooden desk with a type of structure on top. Now we're going to walk to the opened laptop screen that we see in front of us, and this will be our destination.
